/guides/camp-upgrades.angle: Evidence-led camp audit: explain the historical beta camp categories, then turn the page into a decision log rather than a fabricated optimal order.
allowed: Historical beta material described resource-funded camp upgrades that affected Springhorn healing, Warehouse capacity and Gylden Jar limit.
Use a personal “verify in the current build before spending” checklist; qualify all current-tree, price, order, permanence, and reset claims.
prohibited: Do not claim a current upgrade tree, cost, best order, account-wide behavior, seasonal wipe behavior, or permanent status.
Do not call beta values current.
claims: A 2025 beta development log described camp upgrades using gathered resources, including Springhorn healing, Warehouse capacity and Gylden Jar limit; it is historical beta evidence only and cannot establish live costs, order, permanence, or wipe behavior.
S7

/guides/controller-vs-kbm.angle: Input-method setup and patch-awareness: compare player comfort/testing workflow without declaring aim assist, input switching, or class-specific superiority.
allowed: Controller-related bugs were addressed in official July 30/August 6 updates.
Recommend testing a familiar aim/turn scenario after a patch and recording personal comfort.
prohibited: Do not claim aim assist exists, its strength, KBM/controller mid-game switching, default bindings, or a best input per class.
claims: The August 6 official update includes controller-related fixes and a PS/Xbox friends-list crash fix; that supports patch-sensitive wording, not universal controller-performance conclusions.
S4

The July 30 official update documented console reconnect, PS5 display, controller UI and Xbox-PC prompt issues; it does not publish a current PS5/Xbox graphics-mode, FOV, sensitivity, crossplay, or aim-assist specification.
S6

/guides/dual-weapon-stances.angle: Confirmed system overview: describe two stances per class and mid-battle switching, then direct readers to current in-game tooltips for exact skill/cooldown details.
allowed: Six classes each have two unique weapon stances.
Official store marketing describes switching fighting styles during battle.
prohibited: Do not name stance bonuses, cooldowns, swap costs, interrupt rules, class-specific optimal stances, or exact skill lists.
claims: The official Steam listing says the game has six classes, each with two unique weapon stances, and presents switching fighting styles mid-battle as a feature.
S2

/guides/gold-farming.angle: Extraction-risk ledger: distinguish secured returns from speculative loot; make no gold-per-hour, route, flip, vendor, or auction claim.
allowed: The official loop involves gathering loot and extracting it safely; carried spoils are at risk on death.
Use a player-maintained “what was secured vs lost” run log as editorial advice, clearly not an official economy formula.
prohibited: Do not claim gold sources, currency values, gold/hour, chest yield, best loot route, auction house/fees/flips, vendors, or profitability.
claims: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person PvPvE extraction ARPG where players may hunt alone or with allies; death can cost the spoils carried in that run.
S1
Official material identifies Returner Woodling / Soul of Return as an extraction route back to camp; do not state that it is the only currently available extraction method.
S1

/guides/keys-treasure.angle: Treasure-risk orientation: verified official material confirms treasure and spoils in ruins, but the route must withhold key locations, room lists and drop tables.
allowed: Official site says ruins contain treasures guarded by Corroded or Mist Lords.
State that a player should verify a key/door interaction in the current client before committing a risky route.
prohibited: Do not claim keys drop from named sources, treasure-room coordinates, lock requirements, loot tables, event spawns, or key value.
claims: Official site describes treasures in ruins guarded by Corroded or Mist Lords; it does not document keys, rooms, locations, or loot tables.
S1

/guides/pc-settings.angle: PC stability test protocol: use repeatable local testing, and clearly separate display/input/network troubleshooting from unsupported in-game settings claims.
allowed: The official July 30 update planned/required a client update and later notes show active stability work.
Recommend changing one setting at a time and using the game’s current menu/tooltips as the authority.
prohibited: Do not publish GPU presets, FPS caps, render scale, DLSS/FSR status, system requirements as launch-current, FOV ranges, or guaranteed FPS.
claims: Official updates document ongoing client/stability work, so performance advice must be version- and hardware-qualified.
S4

/guides/ps5-settings.angle: PS5 verification checklist: confirm availability/platform evidence, then help the reader test display and connection symptoms without inventing PS5 menu options.
allowed: The official website has a PlayStation destination link, and the July 30 update references a PS5 deck-screen display issue.
Recommend checking the current console/game menu after patches.
prohibited: Do not claim a PS5 graphics mode, FPS, FOV slider, crossplay status, controller aim assist, resolution, HDR behavior, or best sensitivity.
claims: The official site links to PlayStation, and the July 30 update references a PS5-specific display issue; neither source publishes a current PS5 settings matrix.
S1

The July 30 official update documented console reconnect, PS5 display, controller UI and Xbox-PC prompt issues; it does not publish a current PS5/Xbox graphics-mode, FOV, sensitivity, crossplay, or aim-assist specification.
S6

/guides/pvp-survival.angle: Fair-play and extraction-risk framing: focus on deciding whether to disengage, but do not invent matchup counters, rankings or combat rules.
allowed: Official materials frame rival Gyldhunters as a threat and describe death as risking carried spoils.
Recommend using cover, information and an exit plan as general editorial safety heuristics, labeled non-official player advice.
prohibited: Do not claim best PvP class, matchup advantage, third-party detection, damage breakpoints, ranked rules, aim assist, or guaranteed escape tactics.
claims: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person PvPvE extraction ARPG where players may hunt alone or with allies; death can cost the spoils carried in that run.
S1
Official material identifies Returner Woodling / Soul of Return as an extraction route back to camp; do not state that it is the only currently available extraction method.
S1

/guides/scavenger-squads.angle: Legitimate squad coordination: ground the page in official solo/three-player squad framing and distinguish it from unauthorized pre-arranged teaming.
allowed: Official material presents solo or three-player squad play.
State that coordination should use the game’s legitimate party systems and follow current fair-play rules.
prohibited: Do not claim “scavenger squads” are an official mode, their matchmaking rules, a loot split formula, profit rate, or risk-free routes.
claims: Official material presents solo play and three-player squads; do not convert this marketing description into a claim about every matchmaking queue or party restriction.
S2

/guides/solo-survival.angle: Solo extraction decision-making: build around known solo support and patch/roadmap volatility rather than a fixed best-class prescription.
allowed: Official material supports hunting alone.
The August 5 roadmap announced a future Brandrgarde Solo Mode, explicitly as a planned addition.
prohibited: Do not claim current solo queue availability, named solo map rules, best solo class, spawn changes, solo-only extraction rules, or balance values.
claims: Official material presents solo play and three-player squads; do not convert this marketing description into a claim about every matchmaking queue or party restriction.
S2

The August 5 official roadmap announced a planned Brandrgarde Solo Mode for Normal and Cataclysm difficulties in mid-Season 1; it is an announcement, not evidence that the mode was already live when posted.
S5

/guides/xbox-settings.angle: Xbox availability + patch-aware console test routine: cite launch availability, then prohibit unsupported option lists.
allowed: Xbox Wire says the game launched on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC, with Xbox/PC Game Pass availability.
The July 30 update references an Xbox-PC exit prompt issue; official updates show current behavior can change.
prohibited: Do not claim Xbox Series S/X graphics modes, FPS, FOV, crossplay, input latency, aim assist, HDR, resolution, or recommended sensitivity.
claims: Xbox Wire says the game launched on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Game Pass and PC Game Pass on July 29, 2026.
S3
